presentation.speaker: lina
presentation.title: Lina: escrow on delivery
lines: Lina Zhao. Here's the offer, plain.
Escrow: you pay into a contract that holds the money. The supplier ships when they see it locked, and is paid only when your goods arrive.
0.6% fee, $15 minimum, no wire delay. If the goods never come, the contract sends your money back.

choices.label: Open an escrow account
choices.detail: Escrow: the supplier is paid only when the goods arrive. It costs 0.6% and protects you if they never ship. It appears as a payment option when you import.
choices.outcome: Lina: "Done. Use it on one order first and watch what it does."

choices.label: Stay with wires and letters of credit
choices.detail: Nothing changes: you pay abroad the way you did in the Clearing Crisis. You can still ask Lina for escrow later.
choices.outcome: Lina: "Fair. Boring and safe has its place."
